title.fr: Les territoires du Nord et le Yukon

text.en: Yukon, Nunavut and the Northwest Territories together take up one-third of Canada's land.
text.fr: Le Yukon, le Nunavut et les Territoires du Nord-Ouest occupent ensemble le tiers du territoire du Canada.

source.quote: The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon contain one-third of Canada’s land mass

verification.evidence: THE NORTHERN TERRITORIES The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon contain one-third of Canada’s land mass but have a population of only 100,000.

text.en: In winter the sun vanishes in the North, and darkness stays for three months.
text.fr: En hiver, le soleil disparaît dans le Nord et l'obscurité s'installe pour trois mois.

source.quote: In winter, the sun disappears and darkness sets in for three months.

verification.evidence: In winter, the sun disappears and darkness sets in for three months. The Northern territories have long cold winters and short cool summers.

text.en: Today, some people in the North still earn their living by trapping, fishing and hunting.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, des gens du Nord gagnent encore leur vie par le piégeage, la pêche et la chasse.

source.quote: Some continue to earn a living by hunting, fishing and trapping.

verification.evidence: Some continue to earn a living by hunting, fishing and trapping. Inuit art is sold throughout Canada and around the world.

text.en: Art made by Inuit artists is sold today across Canada and in other countries.
text.fr: L'art des Inuit se vend aujourd'hui partout au Canada et à l'étranger.

source.quote: Inuit art is sold throughout Canada and around the world.

verification.evidence: Some continue to earn a living by hunting, fishing and trapping. Inuit art is sold throughout Canada and around the world.

text.en: The White Pass and Yukon Railway first ran in 1900. It linked Skagway, in neighbouring Alaska, with Whitehorse, the capital of the territory.
text.fr: Le chemin de fer White Pass and Yukon Railway a commencé à rouler en 1900. Il reliait Skagway, dans l'Alaska voisin, à Whitehorse, la capitale du territoire.

source.quote: The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened from Skagway in neighbouring Alaska to the territorial capital, Whitehorse in 1900

verification.evidence: The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened from Skagway in neighbouring Alaska to the territorial capital, Whitehorse in 1900 and provides a spectacular tourist excursion across precipitous passes and bridges.

text.en: Today the White Pass and Yukon Railway gives visitors a spectacular ride across steep passes and bridges.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, le White Pass and Yukon Railway offre aux visiteurs un trajet spectaculaire à travers des cols escarpés et des ponts.

source.quote: and provides a spectacular tourist excursion across precipitous passes and bridges

verification.evidence: The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened from Skagway in neighbouring Alaska to the territorial capital, Whitehorse in 1900 and provides a spectacular tourist excursion across precipitous passes and bridges.

text.en: The coldest temperature ever measured in Canada, -63 °C, was reached in Yukon.
text.fr: La température la plus froide jamais mesurée au Canada, -63 °C, l'a été au Yukon.

source.quote: Yukon holds the record for the coldest temperature ever recorded in Canada (-63°C).

verification.evidence: Yukon holds the record for the coldest temperature ever recorded in Canada (-63°C).
